contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals and enterprises creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Hero band followed by a conversion form card, then feature/product sections with repeated headline-description-feature-list structure; content is grouped into clearly separated bands rather than a long continuous narrative.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Functional lead-gen card with solid surface, simple border/shadow treatment implied, compact heading, and stacked form fields; feature content reads as plain content blocks rather than decorative cards.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is prominent in the hero; secondary CTAs are minimal or absent. Product sections use section-level CTAs sparingly, favoring one clear action per module to reduce friction.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing module present; page is positioned as inquiry/demo-driven rather than transactional.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer not visible in the provided reference; likely minimal or outside the captured scope.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: No large product media panel is visible in the captured markup; visual emphasis is text-first with logo/brand image support. If media exists, it is secondary to copy and form conversion.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Modular product-feature sections with a label, headline, body copy, and a list of capability bullets; supports progressive disclosure by presenting overview first, then detailed benefits. Sections can be repeated for multiple products with consistent scaffolding.

referenceMap.animationStyle: Carousel-based hero rotation if enabled; otherwise static, utility-driven presentation with minimal motion implied in the markup.

personality.productType: AI image and video generation platform
personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise content teams
personality.emotion: Premium control, creative confidence, technical sophistication
personality.reasoning: This product is clearly in the AI / generative AI category because it centers on Seedream 4.5 image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro video generation. The visual language should feel cinematic, futuristic, and enterprise-grade: dark, immersive, glass-like surfaces, and violet-cyan AI energy accents. Since the brand palette is fixed to Techjockey's orange, white, and charcoal, the page should use the brand's orange as the key primary CTA and hero anchor while preserving the AI category's high-end, intelligent mood through near-black and deep charcoal support surfaces. The layout should emphasize multimodal capabilities with split panels, tabs, floating chips, and layered product cards to make the experience feel advanced and interactive.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long and detailed, so it needs a smaller, controlled size to preserve premium balance and avoid awkward wrapping.

colours.colourReason: The product must use Techjockey's brand primary #ff6b00 as the hero background anchor and CTA color per brand rules. The supporting palette stays within the provided brand colors: charcoal and white for contrast, with soft grey cards for readability. The AI category is expressed through layout, glow, and glass treatment rather than introducing unsupported purple gradients.

layout.heroBackground: Brand-orange anchored hero with charcoal overlay and glassy product visualization on the right
layout.heroReason: The content benefits from a split hero because the product is highly visual and technically dense. A right-side cinematic mockup can show AI image/video creation outputs, while the left side carries the headline, proof chips, and primary CTA. This creates immediate enterprise credibility and visual clarity.
layout.featureReason: There are two distinct product tracks, Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, so alternating sections create stronger contrast and help users mentally separate image generation from video generation. Each section should use different tonal treatment and content rhythm for premium pacing.
layout.darkSectionFor: Hero, Seedance 1.5 Pro video section, and enterprise infrastructure proof band

personality.imageryDirection: Use a cinematic product composite: floating AI generation canvas, prompt-to-output workflow, sample poster-like image tiles, video timeline strips, and audio waveform overlays. For the hero, show a high-end split-screen mockup of image generation on one side and a video frame/storyboard preview on the other.
personality.designPersonality: A cinematic enterprise AI interface with dark premium depth, orange brand energy, glassy layered panels, and intelligent motion cues. It should feel like a top-tier creative lab for professional teams rather than a generic SaaS dashboard.

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the product category, position both models as premium ByteDance generative tools, and drive the primary conversion action.
Explain the image generation value proposition, highlight core capabilities, and support product evaluation for creative workflows.
Explain the video generation value proposition, differentiate audio-visual synchronization, and support enterprise use-case understanding.
Convert evaluators with quote-oriented package framing and make commercial intent explicit without pushing self-serve purchase behavior.
Reduce hesitation through role-relevant social proof from creative leadership and production roles.

componentNeeds.notes: Use a strong headline hierarchy, short supporting copy, and a compact CTA cluster with one dominant primary action. Because no form is included, the hero must carry the full conversion intent.
Use 2-3 short bullets or proof-led lines to quickly communicate multimodal input, professional output quality, and enterprise suitability.
Structure as a clear product band with headline, descriptive paragraph, then a dense but scannable list of capabilities. Prioritize text rendering, resolution, editing, composition, and fidelity.
The six listed features should be organized for fast scanning; avoid decorative cards unless needed for readability. Keep copy precise and enterprise-oriented.
Present as a separate module with distinct product identity while keeping system consistency. Emphasize synchronized audio-video generation and cinematic control.
Highlight text-to-video, multilingual lip-sync, and speed benefits. Since there is no dedicated CTA, keep the section informative and decision-supportive.
Use one card per product plan. Seedance has the only explicit price; Seedream should feel quote-led. Include checklist-style inclusions and quote CTAs, not checkout UI.
Use three proof points from creative director, video producer, and art director roles. Give each card strong readability and subtle trust framing.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a strong centered or slightly left-aligned single-column hero with a dark, authoritative background and white text. Because no form or media is included, the hero should rely on hierarchy, concise benefit copy, and a prominent CTA to create immediate action.
layoutStrategy.features: Use two separate product bands with consistent scaffolding, clear section labels, and dense but orderly feature lists. Each module should support progressive disclosure: overview first, then functional capability bullets.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place testimonials after pricing to reinforce confidence after the user has understood the offer. Keep social proof role-specific and visually separated from feature content.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Present as a quote-led comparison of the two offerings rather than transactional pricing. Seedream should emphasize request-based engagement, while Seedance can surface its starting monthly price as an anchor.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be designed because includeForm is false. Conversion happens through CTA-led intent, likely to a demo or quote flow outside the page.
